policies: Positive evidence is the default: provider silence, a zero-result query, a missing page, or a false variant flag is unknown unless an exact exhaustive edge explicitly says otherwise.
Authority tier and card-existence capability never imply finish capability or absence capability.
A grading registry, collector registry, marketplace image, owner attestation, or inspected specimen may establish only the concrete positive record it identifies.
Every retained observation keeps its query URL and parameters, retrieval date, source record, and a generated SHA-256 content hash.
Unavailable, incomplete, rate-limited, and browser-blocked surfaces remain visible graph nodes; their failure state must not be converted into a negative verdict.

surfaces.label: Exact official checklist documents
surfaces.freshnessPolicy: Re-download and hash each exact document before a new absence adjudication.

query.pagination: not paginated; completeness belongs only to the named document

timeRange.basis: only the four exact documents named below

absenceCapability.rationale: The exact official checklist is complete for its own labelled product and finish columns; no neighbouring product inherits closure.

outsideScope: any other set, language, product, web search or official page
boundary.challenge: A general official card page outside the four URLs is deliberately retained as an out-of-scope counterexample to provider-wide absence.

timeRange.basis: positive Italian locale detail pages only

absenceCapability.rationale: A returned localized card page establishes that card; filters, missing pages and other locale routes are not a manifest.

boundary.challenge: The archive can ignore filters or omit eras, so only a positively returned matching detail page carries evidence.

surfaces.label: Official Latin-American-Spanish card assets

timeRange.basis: retained positive es-xl card assets with a printed LA modifier only

absenceCapability.rationale: One official LA card image establishes that printed LATAM release only; missing asset paths and neighbouring cards remain unknown.

boundary.challenge: A missing asset path cannot refute a LATAM card, set, variant or finish.
